- spec: docs/tickets/P04.1__connector-framework.md

- branch: devin/p04-1-connector-framework

## Requirements / ACs (from spec)
Deliverables:
1. eight-stage interface (discover→fetch→capture→parse→extract→normalize→link→load), separately
   addressable/retryable, each content-addressed — SIG-INGEST-001; each stage runnable as plain CLI.
2. fetch() only network-egress stage; every post-capture stage pure fn of stored artifacts —
   SIG-INGEST-002; stage idempotency — SIG-INGEST-003.
3. shared rate-limiter + robots layer, per-host budgets, contact UA, crawl-delay; connectors hold no
   HTTP client — SIG-INGEST-011; robots-unretrievable ⇒ refuse — SIG-INGEST-012; no challenge-defeat — SIG-INGEST-013.
4. connector-loader gate: check ingestion_permitted, custody_posture, compact_status BEFORE fetch,
   refuse when absent/unresolved — SIG-INGEST-014, SIG-INGEST-028; export compat per compartment,
   build fails on incompat — SIG-LIC-010.
5. source disappearance as data: 404/removal/persistent-challenge → first-class event row + research
   task, never swallowed exception — SIG-INGEST-009/010.
6. backfill+replay+shadow: replay in network-isolated ctx; shadow diffs new vs current, reports delta
   before asserting — SIG-INGEST-017/018/019; lineage per ingest_run mapped to PROV-O — SIG-INGEST-015/016.

Acceptance criteria:
- AC1 network call after capture() FAILS run (network-isolated replay). deterministic
- AC2 replay over pinned capture digests → byte-identical claims modulo id + sys_period. deterministic
- AC3 shadow mode reports claim-set diff WITHOUT asserting. deterministic
- AC4 404 → event row AND research task, not exception. deterministic
- AC5 robots.txt unretrievable ⇒ refuse to run. deterministic
- AC6 loader refuses connector whose ingestion_permitted/compact_status denies; export mixing
  incompatible licence compartments FAILS build. deterministic
- AC7 phase-gate §51.3: CI green incl DQ checks; new reqs have automated tests; ADRs for deviations;
  traceability updated; risk-register updated.

Out of scope: osm connector (P04.2), atlas (P04.3), records (P07.x), ER/resolver logic (link() calls P03.2).

## Existing substrate to REUSE (not reinvent)
- evidence.ingest_run: IngestRun, canonical_claim_tuple, claim_set_fingerprint (byte-identical replay + shadow diff)
- evidence.disappearance: DisappearanceEvent, record_disappearance, disappearance_task (SIG-INGEST-009/010)
- evidence.store.EvidenceStore.store_capture_set; evidence.capture.RawCapture (capture())
- evidence.digest.multihash (content-addressing)
- policy.licensing: compute_export_license, assert_export_permitted, LicenseIncompatibilityError, compartments (SIG-LIC-010)
- policy.crawler: robots_permits, conduct_rules, assert_no_circumvention, content_signal_permits_training
- resolution.cascade.resolve (link())
- exports.provo: Lineage, build_prov_graph, export_lineage, IngestRun projection (PROV-O map)
- connectors.loader: assert_ingestion_permitted, run_connector (EXTEND for custody+compact+export gate)
- connectors.registry: SourceRecord (custody_posture, compact_status, robots_policy, rights, ingestion_permitted)

## Plan (files, connectors/src/connectors/)
- stages.py: Stage enum + STAGE_ORDER; StageArtifact (content-addressed); Connector ABC with 8 stages;
  run_stage dispatcher; egress-only-in-fetch marker.
- net.py: PoliteFetcher (shared HTTP layer): per-host budget, contact UA, crawl-delay, robots retrieval
  (unretrievable⇒refuse via policy.crawler.robots_permits), no-circumvention. HttpFetcher protocol.
  Connectors receive fetcher; hold no client.
- isolation.py: network_isolated() context manager blocking socket egress (post-capture / replay).
- disappearance.py (connectors): wrap evidence.disappearance → SourceDisappeared handling producing
  event row + research task (SIG-INGEST-009/010).
- lineage.py: build IngestRun + exports.provo.Lineage per run (SIG-INGEST-015/016).
- replay.py: ReplayHarness — replay over pinned capture digests in network-isolated ctx (byte-identical),
  shadow_diff (report delta w/o asserting).
- loader.py (EXTEND): assert_ingestion_permitted → also custody_posture + compact_status gate;
  assert_export_compartment_compatible (SIG-LIC-010).
- cli.py (EXTEND): per-stage run subcommands + replay/shadow subcommands.
- pyproject.toml (EXTEND): add sig-evidence, sig-resolution, sig-exports workspace deps.

Tests: tests/connectors/ (new dir) — test_stages, test_net, test_isolation, test_replay,
test_disappearance, test_loader_gate, test_export_compartment, test_lineage, test_cli.
Docs: ADR for connector framework (eight-stage + net isolation); traceability.md rows; risk_register phase-4 section.
